svg.title: c9-concurrent-same-uri-ingest
svg.desc: c9-concurrent-same-uri-ingest: 9 steps over 1 day from 2026-11-01. Actors: a1 (agent, agent-alpha), a2 (agent, agent-beta), h (human). two sessions ingest one URI at once; one live revision, contiguous numbers, both audited. 1. [0d] in parallel: a1 ingest # Connection pool; a2 ingest # Connection pool. 2. h status; expects 3 things. 3. h history $d1; expects 5 things. 4. h history $d2; expects 2 things. 5. a1 search pool opens connections closes idle; expects 1 thing. 6. [1d] in parallel: a1 ingest # Connection pool; a2 ingest # Connection pool. 7. h status; expects 3 things. 8. h read $d4; expects 2 things. 9. h history $d1; expects 4 things.
